question: Should the draft storage/oracle-cloud-infrastructure-archive-storage (tier Archive, verdict paid-only, identity card) be added as its own record instead of folded into storage/multi-account-multiplication-of-big-cloud-free-tiers?
why: the two are different offers: the existing record is the strategy of several accounts (verdict fails-quota, each account holds its own 20 GB of Always Free Object Storage across Standard, Infrequent Access and Archive), while the draft is one account's Archive tier at its published price; the records differ in verdict, so the existing one stays unchanged and the draft should be added as a separate record
